name: Crypto Derivatives Data API (Remote)
description: Connects to the hosted Crypto Derivatives Data API MCP endpoint: 10 tools for perpetual funding rates and history, funding-rate arbitrage scans, a perp screener, open interest, futures basis, implied volatility, liquidations, order book depth and a derivatives snapshot, aggregated across 8 exchanges (Bybit, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Gate, Kraken Futures, Bitfinex, Deribit, OKX). No account or API key: tools/list is free, and each tool call costs $0.003 to $0.005, paid per call with x402 v2 (USDC on Base), so the client needs an x402-capable wallet.
